t0032-01.gloss: A gate closure appears after the listed shift, with the inside latch still blocked.
t0032-01.rival_reading: A program site could also have been closed to visitors; the late notice and blocked gate do not identify who ordered it.

t0032-02.gloss: A grounds test and a locked gate leave a delivery outside its expected handoff.
t0032-02.rival_reading: Emergency crews could have restricted access and returned sealed containers; the note does not say what was inside.
